verdict.rationale: Google Voice ships its own call-event automation: admins design auto-attendant menus that route incoming callers to people or departments, ring groups with distribution rules such as round robin, and automatic call recording on higher tiers. These are fixed telephony routing features rather than a general user-defined rules engine for triggering arbitrary actions on events. missing for 10: a general-purpose event/trigger rule builder, rules on events beyond inbound call routing (e.g., SMS, voicemail), configurable actions beyond routing and recording, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
